flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui pages/NoticeUPL/{List/EndorseList,Form/{ModalForm,EndorseForm},Hooks/useEndorsement}, utils/mapping/NoticeUPL.ts, utils/config/env.ts, utils/data/LinkData.tsx, App.tsx, pages/Dashboard/Dashboard.tsx. ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, ocmseserviceapi, thirdpartyapi: no receiver for approvalinbox, workitem or the UPL_APPROVAL command
note: Status sheet: Requirement given - Gen flow. The story asks for endorsement from a dashboard work item with re-route + alert on rejection. Only the UPL endorsement screen exists in the UI (EndorseList, EndorseForm), and it does not appear in DEV/UAT/PRO because the list waits for approvalinbox, which is called only when isAPIFound (STAGING/LOCAL, env.ts:11); the UPL menu is commented out. Rejection does nothing (useEndorsement.tsx:201-203): no re-route and no alert. No backend receiver for approvalinbox/workitem/UPL_APPROVAL exists in the repos. Sibling OCMS13.5-13.7 cover the same UPL flow and should stay consistent. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Very limited claim. Only the UPL endorsement screen (UI) exists and is not proven active in URA environments; re-route on reject, the alert to the OIC and the dashboard do not exist. Align with OCMS13.5-13.7.

steps.step: An endorsement work item is routed to the officer's dashboard
steps.detail: There is no dashboard (Dashboard.tsx:26-29 is empty). The UPL endorsement list (route App.tsx:85) is not a dashboard and does not read work items: it reads the 'approvalinbox' resource (EndorseList.tsx:36-53), only when isAPIFound. The 'UPL Endorsement' work item the UI creates uses allocated_to = the creating user (NoticeUPL.ts:192-195, '//! Hard code'), not the endorsing officer. No receiver for approvalinbox/workitem exists in the six repos.

steps.step: The officer clicks the work item and views the decision made (e.g. mention outcome)
steps.detail: The Endorsement list shows UPL notices (stage NPA, decision not yet Y) with an 'Endorse' button that opens a modal; ENDORSE mode shows DecisionRequestDetail (ModalForm.tsx:302). But the list renders only when 'notices' is not null (EndorseList.tsx:81) and 'notices' is filled only when isAPIFound (EndorseList.tsx:52; env.ts:11: STAGING or LOCAL), so in DEV/UAT/PRO the list is not shown. The UPL menu is also commented out (LinkData.tsx:397). The real VITE_ENV cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The officer endorses or rejects the decision
steps.detail: EndorseForm offers a Decision Y/N choice and a Remark (EndorseForm.tsx:44 ff.); submit runs useEndorsement.onEndorseAPI, which POSTs the UPL_APPROVAL workflow (useEndorsement.tsx:155-163, mapping NoticeUPL.ts:104-127). The UPL_APPROVAL command does not exist in the backend (grep in ocmsadminapi and ocmsadminprivateapi: 0 hits), so the server effect cannot be verified from the repo; the UI raises an error when the response lacks notice_no (:159-163).

steps.step: The endorsement outcome is recorded (officer, date, remark)
steps.detail: MapPatchApprovalInbox in ENDORSE mode fills approval, approval_officer, approval_date, remark_approval (NoticeUPL.ts:159-163) and PATCHes 'approvalinbox' only when isAPIFound (useEndorsement.tsx:167-185), i.e. STAGING/LOCAL. No approvalinbox entity exists in the backend repos, so storage cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: If rejected, the work item is re-routed to the OIC who sent it
steps.detail: A code comment says 'Decision N would do nothing' (useEndorsement.tsx:201-203): the stage changes only when approval == 'Y' (:188), and no new work item or allocated_to change occurs on rejection. No re-route code exists in the six repos (grep reassign/allocate/routed: no relevant hits).

steps.step: An alert is sent to the dashboard of the OIC who routed the notice
steps.detail: There is no dashboard with alerts (Dashboard.tsx:26-29) and no officer alert entity or endpoint in the six repos (see the notification step in OCMS38.1).
